lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Clay! Watch your left foot. Corinne's built something down there.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Oh. Is it a house?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: A bakery, apparently. I stepped on the first one. She's charging me two pebbles.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I've got dried fruit in my pouch, if you're hungry.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: How much dried fruit?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I should have guessed that would be your first question.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Reed used to check on all of us before he went to sleep. Every single night.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Sounds like Reed.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I still do the counting sometimes. Even here.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Kai asked if we could race. I said he could choose the finish line.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Under a tree root. I think I've been tricked.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Do you remember when you first came looking for us?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I was worried you wouldn't want me there.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: We wanted you to stay. I don't think I said that properly.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I wanted to. I still like coming back.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Camille's drawing the whole village. She made my pouch enormous.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Maybe she's hoping there's lunch in it.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: There was. You ate it.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: It's quiet today. I keep waiting for someone to shout an order.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: We could sit here a while.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I'd like that. Leave a bit of room for the little ones.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll move my tail.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Sora would've found the shady spot already. She always does.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: We could save it for her.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: The one by the wallow? Yes. She'd like that.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Corinne asked about my scar. Then she asked if scars need blankets.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: What did you tell her?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: That mine was warm enough. She gave me a leaf anyway.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: A leaf blanket. That's a new one.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I can hear three different frogs in those reeds. That low one's only just started.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll sit here. Maybe he'll do it again.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I like seeing you with them. You put your head down so they can reach you.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: They're very small.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: So was I, once. Reed had to help me out of my egg.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I'm trying to keep the mud out of this pouch.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: In a MudWing village?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Yes, thank you, Clay. I'm beginning to see the problem.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: We could show the kids the wallow later. The shallow edge.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll go in first and check it.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: And come back out when we call you? Camille asked me to check that part.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I used to think meeting new dragons would be easy at school.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Was it?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Sometimes. It's easier when someone saves you a place to sit.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: You can sit by me.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Want to walk with me? I was going as far as the bend.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Are we looking for anything?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: No. I thought we could have a walk without looking for anything.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Come on, then.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Corinne put a pebble in my pouch for luck. Kai put in another one.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: What did Camille put in?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: A note asking me to stop carrying everybody's rocks.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: You've got a leaf stuck behind your horn.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Can you reach it?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Hold still. You're much too tall for this to be convenient.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll crouch down. How about now?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I found a dry patch big enough for all of us. I checked there's room for your tail.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Thanks. I'll bring the others over.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Clay, how far can you jump? Past that stump?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Probably. Are you standing on the stump?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Not anymore. Give me a second.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: I found a shortcut. Camille says it goes the wrong way.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Where were you trying to go?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: That depends where it comes out.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Umber let me hold his pouch. I had to use both hands.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: What would you keep in a pouch that big?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: String. A stick. Another stick, in case the first one breaks.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Could you see our footprints from the air?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Yours might be a bit small.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Camille and I are both nine. She says she's in charge of the map.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: What are you in charge of?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Finding things that aren't on it yet.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Try finding us somewhere to have lunch.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: There's something moving by that root.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: A lizard, I think.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Oh, good. I told Corinne it was a lizard. I wasn't sure.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: I can balance on one foot longer than you.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I've got four feet. Which one?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: You have to pick three up. Those are the rules now.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Would a dragon fit in a scavenger house?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I think I'd get stuck at the door.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: We could make the door bigger. Mum might notice.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: I promised Camille I'd stay where she could see me.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Can she see you here?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Yes. She keeps pointing at me.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'd stay close. She looks worried.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: I was going to name this stick, but Corinne's already named it Peter.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Does Peter do anything?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Mostly gets borrowed. Have you seen Corinne?

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Do your wings get tired?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: They do after a long flight.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Can we come back here tomorrow? I haven't checked behind the big house.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: We'll ask the dragons who live there first.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Okay. You ask. You can reach the door.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Clay, hold still. I'm drawing your horns.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Like this?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Yes. Oh, your head's too big for this bit of paper. I'll turn it sideways.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Corinne says she isn't tired. She asked me to carry her shoes.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I can carry both of you if you need a rest.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Thanks. I'll ask her again in a minute.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll be here.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Kai's shortcut brought us back to the same tree.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Maybe he likes that tree.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: He said it was a different tree. It still had my ribbon on it.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Umber remembered which fruit Corinne likes. She only told him once.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: He listens.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: She told him all about breakfast today. He might regret it.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I don't think he minds.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: I'm marking the dry ground on our map. That patch wasn't dry.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Your boots look muddy.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Kai keeps saying he's nearly ten. His birthday's ages away.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Is yours soon?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: No. We're both nine for a while yet. I keep telling him.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Could you put your tail on the other side of the path?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Sorry. Is it in the way?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Corinne thinks it's a bridge. I'm trying to get her down.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: My hair caught on a branch again. Is there still a twig in it?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: A small one, on your left.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Can you tell Kai? He said I imagined it.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Kai? Camille's got a twig in her hair.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: I packed three snacks. Corinne ate one, Kai ate one, and I ate one.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: That sounds fair.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: They were meant for the journey home. We might need to leave after lunch.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Corinne wants to sleep in a dragon house tonight.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: There's plenty of room.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: She also wants you to say good night to every one of her pebbles.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: I drew you and Umber together. I made him smaller.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: He'll probably check how much smaller.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: I can rub that bit out if he complains.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: We should sit down for a bit. Kai keeps running ahead.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll save him a spot.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Next to you, please. Then he might stay for five minutes.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Clay! Put your head down. Lower. Lower than that.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: How's this?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Good. There was a bug on you. It's gone now.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Hold your foot up. I want to count the pointy bits.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I can hold it here. Take your time.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: This pebble's for Umber. You can have this one.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Thank you. Why that one?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: It's bigger. Your pockets must be bigger.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Camille says we can't take a frog home.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Where would it sleep?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: In Kai's bag. He hasn't said no yet.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: I made a bakery. Umber stepped in it.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Can you fix it?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Yes. But now he has to buy a cake.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Your eye's bigger than my hand.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Do you want to see it blink?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Again! Both this time.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: All right. Watch.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Kai said Peter was a sword. Peter is a stick.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Could he be both?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: He can be a spoon. I'm making soup.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Will you come when we go home?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: I'll walk with you for a bit.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: All the way to the next tree? It's far.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: We can go as slowly as you like.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Umber gave me a leaf. I gave it back for his nose.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Was his nose cold?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: I forgot to ask. Can you ask him?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Camille's my sister. You can sit with us, though.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Thanks. Where should I sit?

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: There. Careful of the bakery.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: I saw a fish! It went under and it didn't come back.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: It might be hiding.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Then we have to look away. You're looking, Clay.

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: All right. Tell me when I can look again.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Can I touch your claw? Just the end?

lines.speaker: Clay
lines.text: Gently. I'll keep still.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: It's smooth. I thought it would feel like a rock.
